policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="estimatedTokens" value="@{
            var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
            var prompt = body?.GetValue("prompt")?.ToString() ?? "";
            return prompt.Length / 4; // Rough token estimate
        }" />
        
        
            <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("estimatedTokens", 0) > 100000)">
                
                    
                    {"error": "token_limit_exceeded", "message": "Request exceeds maximum token limit"}
                
            
        
        
        
        
            Claude-Service
